justification: Carry the LMR/SEPP citation end-to-end so the capacity card's LMR note cites the real clause, and gate the note on a citation (no clause -> no claim). Fixes the #566 gap where the card asserted an LMR conclusion with no source even though housing_sepp_standards holds the clause. Verified live: the uplift returns clause 172(2)(a), 'SEPP (Housing) 2021 - LMR Amendment', legislation.nsw.gov.au, effective 2025-02-28.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards already has source_clause/source_document/legislation_url/effective_date/verified_at. _fetch_standards_grouped dropped them. Live-verified clauses: multi_dwelling 172(2)*, residential_flat_r1r2 174, r3r4_inner 175, r3r4_outer 176.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The #566 note assumed attribution was enough; the product requires a surfaced citation. The clause existed in the DB but was never carried through.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new source or query — extends the existing _fetch_standards_grouped SELECT (same table) to read the citation columns. FormEligibility + _lmr_uplift_form + ConstraintArithmeticResult carry it; a shared _apply_lmr_attribution gates the claim.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Fail-safe preserved: any eligibility/query failure -> _lmr_uplift_form (None, None) -> _apply_lmr_attribution sets ceiling_from_lmr False -> no note. No new external call.
pre_impl.frontend_type: TypeScript: 4 lmr_* citation fields added; the note renders ONLY when ceiling_from_lmr && lmr_source_clause, with the clause + document + legislation link. tsc passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'Higher limit available here under the Low & Mid-Rise Housing reforms' with NO citation. After: 'Higher limit under SEPP (Housing) 2021 - LMR Amendment cl 172(2)(a) (from 2025-02-28)' linking legislation.nsw.gov.au; if no clause is available, no note at all.

functions.name: _apply_lmr_attribution
functions.input: the constraint result, the geometric ceiling_from_lmr flag, and the uplift citation dict (or None)
functions.output: sets ceiling_from_lmr + the lmr_* citation fields ONLY when the ceiling was raised by LMR AND a real source_clause exists
functions.if_none: no citation -> ceiling_from_lmr forced False (no uncited claim); None result -> no-op

functions.name: _lmr_uplift_form
functions.input: zone, lat, lng, lot area/width, heritage
functions.output: (densest eligible engine form, citation dict) for the winning form, or (None, None)
functions.if_none: no eligible form or any error -> (None, None); a form with no source_clause -> (form, None)

values: N/A - no hardcoded regulatory values. The clause/document/url/date come from housing_sepp_standards; the engine reads, never invents them.
queries: N/A for new queries - extends the existing housing_sepp_standards SELECT in _fetch_standards_grouped to read citation columns already on the table; no new table or endpoint.

break_it.scenario: LMR raises the ceiling but no clause exists for the winning form
break_it.what_happens: an uncited LMR claim would appear (the exact product failure)
break_it.how: _apply_lmr_attribution forces ceiling_from_lmr False when no clause; the card gates the note on lmr_source_clause

break_it.scenario: The eligibility / 776 query fails at request time
break_it.what_happens: the note could show on an unknown state
break_it.how: no uplift -> no citation -> no note; base ceiling stands; brief never blocked

break_it.scenario: effective_date is a date object that must serialise to JSON
break_it.what_happens: a raw date could break model_dump / the SSE payload
break_it.how: the citation carries effective_date as an ISO string

break_it.scenario: The base LEP already permits the density (LMR not the reason)
break_it.repro: ceiling_from_lmr only True on a strict raise (existing 3a/attribution test); 14 Stanley/Mascot stay False
break_it.how: the geometric flag gate AND the citation gate both must pass

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - backend auto-deploys on Railway from GitHub.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief on a lot where LMR strictly raises the ceiling: the capacity card shows 'Higher limit under SEPP (Housing) 2021 ... cl <clause> (from <date>)' linking legislation.nsw.gov.au. On a lot whose base LEP already permits the density, or where no clause exists, no LMR note appears.
